purpose: Fail closed before and throughout realtime reflection-probe synchronization unless the machine-readable material registry still matches the actual active Unity Material assets and the scene-save-built facade glazing gasket remains structurally/materially valid. This protects the cubemap baseline from physically invalid or stale registered materials and from a missing/stale glass-to-sash interface that MainCamera pre-cull alone would not protect; it does not award Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: The binding proves source/runtime material-contract coherence and read-only glazing-gasket construction coherence at each reflection-lighting fingerprint evaluation; it does not prove final BRDF appearance, filtered texture response, Fresnel behavior or highlight plausibility.

The glazing-gasket validation proves the persisted structural state sent to ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe; it does not prove that the 10 mm interface is visually proportionate, free of black-halo artifacts, or free of subpixel shimmer in the final camera views.
A passing binding cannot clear any critical defect without sealed native-4K rendered evidence and the required human frontal/oblique/grazing pixel review.
Unity compile/runtime behavior remains unverified until a real Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner executes the packet.
